items.title: Submit foreign address certification
items.quote:
Please complete the enclosed address certification and mail or upload it by January 15,
2027.
items.computation: The letter states an explicit calendar date by which the completed address certification must be mailed or uploaded: January 15, 2027. This is a US bank's internal administrative deadline, not a German statutory period, so no BGB day-counting or German public-holiday adjustment applies; the stated date is taken as given.

warnings: The sender is a US bank (Example Prairie Savings Bank, Des Moines, Iowa, USA) writing to a customer in Germany; no German authority or law is involved, so none of the German delivery-fiction or BGB period rules apply to this deadline.

The consequence for missing the deadline (restriction of online account access) should be verified directly with the bank via a known, trusted contact channel before acting, since the letter's own contact details were not independently verified.
